answer: Milestone bonds stop bulk fakes: four tranches, one per milestone. Each identity locks 60 credits, plants four trees in a grove, one each epoch, each with 15 credits of signed work in the atlas. A rented receipt mismatches its key in the atlas and burns the bond; a miss sends a ripple to the next tranche. Each fake costs 60 plus 4x15, or 120 credits; 1,000 cost 120,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep every tranche.
